title.narrative: Voluntary Contribution to the OECD DCD-DAC Programme of Work and Budget (PWB)

description.narrative:
Voluntary Contribution to the OECD DCD-DAC is the Norwegian annual contribution to the Programme of Work and Budget (PWB), first for the periode 2023-2024 and then for the periode 2025-2026. The objective with the volutary contribution is to support knowledge-based cooperation between donors on development policy, with emphasis on DAC's core areas. The OECD/DAC has a central role in the international development policy as a forum of many of the largest providers of aid. Its core activities include monitoring Official Development Assistance (ODA), setting development co-operation standards, providing guidance on policy approaches, and conducting regular peer reviews of its members. Norway is an active participant in the DAC committee and its subsidiary bodies.
The expected results of the Programme is that the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development is improved, and progress is made in inclusive and sustainable economic development, the advancement of equalities within and among countries, poverty eradication, and improvement of living standards in developing countries. The expected effects of the Programme is that development co-operation policies are more evidence-based, coherent, and effective, and that DAC members and all development co-operation stakeholders use improved policies, systems, capacities, finance, and partnerships.
